name: PCI DSS
source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 requirement numbering; SCRS evidence views, not the standard's text

requirements.title: Security vulnerabilities are identified and ranked
requirements.evidence: Open register entries per asset ranked by severity, with KEV and EPSS exploitation context and the advisory sources each relies on.

requirements.title: Inventory of bespoke, custom and third-party software components
requirements.evidence: A software bill of materials for each assessed revision, with history; assets without a recent SBOM are listed as gaps.

requirements.title: Security patches and updates are installed in a timely manner
requirements.evidence: Critical and high vulnerabilities open longer than the patch window (default 30 days critical, 90 days high), and the share fixed within it.
